statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The diagnosis codes I48.91, I49.5, and I49.9 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities
The monitoring is required to evaluate the history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias
